features.name: oc_contrasts_op_with_personal_experience
features.definition: Does at least one counter-argument comment explicitly contrast the OP's view with a relatable real-world personal experience?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments (JSON list of comments by users other than the OP). Return 1 if at least one single comment explicitly sets the OP's stated view (as in title/argument, used only to identify the view) against a real, relatable personal experience (the commenter's own or a first-hand account of a real person they describe) that is offered as a contrast to that view. Hypothetical scenarios, generic statistics, and purely abstract arguments do not count; experiences merely quoted as background and not adopted as the commenter's contrast do not count. Do not count OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome resolution updates or reports of the outcome as evidence. Return 0 if the list is valid but empty or no comment qualifies; null if OC_comments is missing or malformed.

h0: oc_contrasts_op_with_personal_experience has no association with the likelihood of view change (delta).
h1: Discussions with oc_contrasts_op_with_personal_experience=1 have a higher likelihood of view change than those with 0.
note: Presence interpretation (at least one comment). "Relatable" is judged by the annotator as a general, understandable real-life experience; no scale is invented. Comment order and timing are unknown. Current text may contain outcome announcements, which are excluded from semantic evidence. OLS on the binary delta gives a linear probability association, not causal.
